name: stepwarden
description: Every Claude Code tool call, checked before it runs, using TypeSafe AI's Jev model.

scripts.types: echo 'Run /plugin-types inside a Claude Code session to regenerate .claude/types/'
scripts.typecheck: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('.claude/types/claude-code.d.ts') || (console.error('.claude/types/ is missing. Run /plugin-types inside a Claude Code session in this checkout first.'), process.exit(1))" && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm run test
